verdict.rationale: Lighthouse's pricing page says it prepares responses to Requests for Evidence at no extra fee, within its flat-price model. Its EB-1A guide also discusses how RFEs and NOIDs affect approval odds, so RFE response work is part of the service rather than only clean first filings. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that NOID responses are handled, documentation of how RFE response work is carried out (attorney involvement, timelines, evidence gathering), and independent or customer corroboration of RFE response outcomes.
